notes.title: Update Preview
notes.notes:
﻿I haven't released any news for a long time. It's not that I ran away. It's that I have been working all day and night. Now I have done a phase, so I will release some completed content:

1. Skill tree: There are a total of 8 active skills and 24 passive skills, which can be categorized into 4 schools, and players can freely mix and match skills

notes.title: Instructions for making major updates
notes.notes:
Since the game was released, there have been constant negative reviews, and I have read all the negative reviews and have been constantly improving them,
﻿
But the results have been minimal, and I don't know where the problem lies T_T
﻿
I think there may be a problem with the essence of the game. It lacks soul, and players seem to be playing a monster killing simulator, while our protagonist "Li Mengxin" is like a ruthless monster killing machine.
﻿
So I plan to spend a few months doing a good update, an update that endows ("Li Mengxin" and this post apocalyptic world) with a soul.
﻿
Stay tuned ^_^

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666271/8168972b21eb01815e12b42a192488cf145b7ce9.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 2024-3-9 Update Instructions
notes.notes:
I'm sorry that it took so long to update. The main problem is that the illusory engine has caused problems. It took 10 days to pack and report errors. Then the illusory engine was upgraded to 5.3 and no errors were reported. However, 5.3 had serious performance problems. I even made two completely different levels in the fourth level of defense mode, one of which was abandoned due to the performance of 5.3. O (╥ ﹏ ╥) o

Then when I returned to version 5.0, there was still no way to report errors. I tried all the possible methods (the illusory engine was reinstalled, the game version was rolled back to 1.0 with svn, and the system was reinstalled). It was an error when packaging the compressed file, and I couldn't find out what the problem was. O (╥ ﹏ ╥) o

There is no way out. It took 20 days to solve the problem. No one on the Internet made the same mistake. Sorry, the final solution is to change the compression method, so this update has a full 15G. O (╥ ﹏ ╥) o

The following is the content of this update:

1. Updated the fourth level of defense mode

2. Now shield will be ignored for falling damage

3. Reduces the probability of the enemy shooting through the wall

4. Replaced some UI images

5. Modified the compression algorithm of the game to reduce the hard disk capacity occupied by the game

6. Fixed the problem of not giving parts in some cases when settling in defensive mode
